title: Section
description: A titled part of a screen: the heading, what it says about itself, the controls beside it, and the widgets standing under it.

controls.label: Controls
controls.hint: Widgets standing at the end of the heading row. They govern this section and nothing else.

widgets.label: Widgets
widgets.hint: Each widget you place stands in the body, in the order listed here.

getHeading.label: Get heading
getHeading.hint: What this part of the screen is.

getBadgeTone.label: What the badge says it is
getBadgeTone.hint: The colour a badge wears is its meaning: a count is neutral, a problem is an error.

getBadge.label: Get badge
getBadge.hint: A count or a state, beside the heading. It says something about the body, never a filter.

getFilling.label: What fills it
getFilling.hint: Placed: you put each widget in yourself. Per row: one widget is drawn again for every row of the data.

options.label: One widget per row of data

getArrangement.label: How they stand
getArrangement.hint: A column reads down with nothing under it. A row and a grid give each widget its own plate. Rows stand in one plate with a line between them.

options.label: Across the row, a plate each
A grid that wraps, a plate each

getMinWidthPx.label: Narrowest a cell may be
getMinWidthPx.hint: The grid fits as many across as this allows, then wraps.

getItems.label: Rows to draw
getItems.hint: Bind the folder whose notes this section draws. The widget in the slot draws one of them at a time.

getPageSize.label: Rows drawn
getPageSize.hint: How many rows are drawn before the rest are asked for.
